主要内容: Khanna resigned from his position as Senior Vice President, Applied Technology on July 21, 2017, but will continue to serve as Senior Vice President of the Company and as a member of its executive committee until his retirement on December 31, 2017, subject to the terms of the Agreement. He will receive his current base salary and participate in the Company’s bonus plan and benefit plans during the Agreement term. Upon termination of employment on December 31, 2017, he will receive continued salary and subsidized COBRA coverage for 12 months, along with accelerated vesting of stock options and restricted stock units. Severance benefits are contingent on execution and non-revocation of a release of claims and compliance with restrictive covenants through December 31, 2018. The report was signed by Sherry L. Buck, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, on July 26, 2017.
